entities.name: Gamma-glutamyl phosphate reductase
observations: The 411-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q7M8Z4 from Wolinella succinogenes.
Catalyzes NADPH-dependent reduction of L-glutamate 5-phosphate to L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde and phosphate.
The semialdehyde product spontaneously cyclizes to 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate.
Assigned EC 1.2.1.41; cytoplasmic enzyme in L-proline biosynthesis.
Sequence contains an Aldedh domain (PF00171) spanning approximately residues 2–273.
Sequence-derived size is approximately 44.97 kDa; predicted pI approximately 6.21.

entities.name: Gamma-glutamyl phosphate reduction
observations: Overall reaction: L-glutamate 5-phosphate + NADPH + H+ → L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP+.
The product L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde spontaneously cyclizes to 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate.
Rhea reference: RHEA:19541; EC classification: EC 1.2.1.41.

entities.name: L-proline biosynthesis
observations: Gamma-glutamyl phosphate reductase catalyzes the second and final step from L-glutamate 5-phosphate toward L-glutamate 5-semialdehyde in the proline biosynthetic pathway.
